meta.title: Mobile Vendor Bidding: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Use the mobile vendor app to verify that bidding is unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant and available on an Enterprise-plan tenant, including switching between the two plan tenants.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Use the mobile vendor app to verify that bidding is unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant and available on an Enterprise-plan tenant, including switching between the two plan tenants.

args.need: sign in as the vendor in the mobile app, verify Mobile Vendor Bidding is refused or absent on the Growth-plan tenant, repeat the same bidding flow on an Enterprise-plan tenant, and verify it works

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the mobile app or determine and compare tenant plan entitlements.
Confirms the accessible vendor sign-in surface after the tester interaction, but does not assert mobile bidding availability.
